subject: Request: Strategic credit framework for CrestonRx enterprise pilot
messages:
From: Evan Caldwell <evan.caldwell@crestonrx.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: Allison Park <apark@crestonrx.com>, procurement@crestonrx.com
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Initial ask — pricing for 3yr committed package / pilot scope

Hi Stephanie,

Great conversation yesterday — thanks for walking us through Redwood's latency guarantees and the Dedicated offering. CrestonRx is preparing a three-year procurement plan for our inference stack and we are evaluating both cost and operational compliance.

High-level ask: what level of unit discount can Redwood provide if we commit to a 3-year reserved capacity agreement (base 2M tokens/mo equivalent) and include a 6-month pilot that requires a private VPC deployment and SOC2 evidence? Our procurement team will need the commercial ask turned into a single-line commitment for approvals.

I've attached a short requirements summary (crestonrx_commercial_request.pdf). Can you put together an illustrative quote and let me know what needs executive sign-off?

Thanks,
Evan Caldwell
Head of Platform Engineering
CrestonRx

---
Attachment: crestonrx_commercial_request.pdf (application/pdf)
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Evan Caldwell <evan.caldwell@crestonrx.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial ask — pricing for 3yr committed package / pilot scope

Hi Evan — thanks for the summary and the attachment. I spoke with Marissa and we drafted a starting commercial: 18% off list on the hosted token rate with a three-year commitment + $40k one-time private deployment setup fee (for VPC + SOC2 evidence support).

Two quick notes:
- To get to your target TCO we'd need to consider quantization recommendations and an optimistic batching profile — we can include Optimize recommendations in the SOW.
- Anything >20% total discount or changes to standard 90-day payment terms will require commercial exception approval (VP/CFO).

If you're comfortable with the draft, we'll run an internal exception brief to request sign-off for any additional concession. I'll loop in Marissa and Jonas to prepare the internal memo.

Next steps:
1) Confirm the commitment size (tokens/month).
2) If you need deeper discounting or payment flexibility, flag that this week so we can move it to finance review.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial exception brief: CrestonRx — business case for strategic credit

Jonas / Markus / Mina —

Following Stephanie's call with CrestonRx, I'm submitting a short exception brief so we can consider a one-time expanded commercial concession. Key points:

Summary:
- CrestonRx is a high-priority prospect in the retail-pharma vertical; strong buy signals: pilot with private deployment + plan for 3yr reserved capacity.
- Proposed baseline: 18% off list + $40k setup. CrestonRx asked whether we can move to 28% off with a 60% pre-pay in year 1 to get their procurement through legal.

Why approve an expanded concession?
- Upside: estimated $3.6M revenue over 3 years; potential channel partnership for pharmacy integrations.
- Competitive risk: two competitors are showing similar dedicated VPC offers — pricing will be decisive.

Risk & guardrails:
- Margin erosion if we exceed 25% discount without pre-pay or additional guardrails.
- Need clear acceptance criteria for the pilot and a milestone-based payout schedule.

Recommendation:
- Approve up to 25% off list conditional on: 50% pre-pay year 1, milestone-driven pilot acceptance, and a one-time onboarding fee bumped to $60k to cover private deployment overheads.
- Anything above 25% must be escalated to VP/CFO approval (Jonas/Markus).

Attachments: commercial-exception-brief.pdf (includes model P&L and milestone map).

Please advise — we'd like to respond to procurement by end of day Tue (23 Nov).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: commercial-exception-brief.pdf (application/pdf)
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial exception brief: CrestonRx — business case for strategic credit

Team —

Thanks for the briefing, Marissa. I reviewed the attached P&L and the risk guardrails. I'm comfortable approving a constrained exception with the following conditions:

Approved concession:
- Up to 25% off list pricing (not combinable with other promotional credits).
- One-time onboarding fee: $60,000 (non-refundable).
- Payment terms: 50% pre-pay at signature, remainder net 60 days tied to milestone acceptance.

Required operational controls:
- Milestone schedule added to SOW with three acceptance gates (pilot infra, model-quality signoff, production readiness). Payouts tied to gates.
- RedTeam/Compliance to confirm SOC2 evidence delivery before production cutover.
- Legal to draft an amendment preserving Redwood's right to revert to standard rates if usage deviates by >40% from forecast in any rolling 90-day window.

If you want us to consider >25% (to 28%), you'd need an exec-signed memo showing why it's strategically necessary (channel or reference commitments) — include an exec sponsor from CrestonRx.

Markus
Markus Klein
Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Evan Caldwell <evan.caldwell@crestonrx.com>, Allison Park <apark@crestonrx.com>

Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Approved: concession up to 25% / next steps and DocuSign

Evan / Allison —

Good news: Redwood can approve a commercial concession up to 25% off list for the 3-year reserved capacity deal, with the following commercial terms (as approved by our finance team):

- Discount: 25% off list pricing (applies to committed tokens only).
- Onboarding: $60,000 one-time, payable 50% at signature.
- Payment: 50% pre-pay at signature, remainder net 60 days and tied to milestone acceptance.
- Deliverables: private VPC setup, SOC2 evidence package delivery, Optimize recommendations in SOW.

I'm attaching the amendment for signature and a DocuSign link for the commitment. If you require a deeper commercial concession (>25%), please introduce an exec sponsor from CrestonRx and we will consider a further exception.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/abcdef-CRX-amendment

Next steps:
- Please confirm token commitment and counter-sign by EOD Fri (26 Nov) if you want the proposed pre-pay schedule.
- We'll kick off RedTeam compliance review once DocuSign is complete.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
